vb_textbox.text: My advice for you to collect the most mushrooms is to begin the game by choosing the lighter and brighter Gnomes plus the purple Gnomes. This is the first set. Once the number of mushrooms begins to decline, switch to the second set by choosing the darker color Gnomes plus the pink Gnome. You'll notice throughout the game that the basket colors will change depending on which set you choose (red basket for lighter + purple) and (yellow basket for darker + pink). Ensure that you stick with this pattern to keep receiving higher numbers of mushrooms. Don't commit to one group the whole game.
